참고로 저는 F고 20년 지기는 T입니다. 대화 많이 하고 서로에 대해 기억하고 이해안되도 허용되는 부분은 넘어가고 역지사지도 하는 등 할 수 있는 부분들만 잘 해도 인간관계가 오래 유지 됩니다.

이건 T/F의 상처받고 화나는 기준 차이 때문임.결과중시 과정중시 이런 기준도 다 다른만큼 그냥 사고방식자체가 너무 다름. 그래서 T는 스스로 느끼기엔 괜찮은 말이 F에겐 상처가 될 수 있음. 근데 이부분에서 T는 또 F를 봤을 때 별거아닌걸로 상처 받아서 찡찡된다고 생각하거나 별거아닌걸로 화를 낸다고 생각함. 
결론은 그냥 T랑 F는 친구하기힘듦. 친구로 오래남는 방식은 서로 T랑 F인걸 받아들이고 무슨일 생기면 쟨 F여서 나랑 다르니까 저렇게 생각하고 행동할 수 있겠구나.. 인정하고 존중해주면 됨.

Yes I agree with you, I'm also a dominant T (INTJ on MBTI and T on STIFiN) who think others' feelings are important. Sometimes I act selfish/too blunt but I try to fix that part every day. Because it's important if you want to have good relationships with everyone, and it's something that definitely has caused problems to me in the past. Empathy emerge from kindness, and kindness isn't something reserved to an T or F type.

Tbh the MBTI is a bit false imo, people shouldn't define their lives based on it. There are tons of people in this world with tons of different experiences & lives, so ofc there should be more than 1000 personalities out there. Categorizing it into 16 is a bit.... lololol if you think about it, the percentage doesn't match up. MBTI is a HUGE generalization, from my perspective it only says about 20-40% of your or others' personalities. I doubt everyone here delve in psychology major or books that much either haha it's funny how everyone talk about how a T or an F should behave when they don't even know the topic that much, perhaps even feed by internet only contents lol.

And if people still talk high and mighty or justify themselves because they're a T, let me be as oblivious and immature as they are and tell them: a true T FIX their problems, not justify themselves. Know how when we are encountered a problem we search for solutions instead of comforting people? Well, high functioning T should be able to tell what is the problem and find a solution. From this video, MC should talk honestly with the other girl about what she meant and why she was like that, and how to fix both of their problems. Even while consulting to Bokyung, the MC just kept denying how the other person feels. That's not how problem-solving works. You don't meet variable A in your research, then deny it and say it should be B without researching first the difference between A & B.

My point is, people who doesn't try to change their bad aspects for the better will never stand high on the ladder. Life is about learning, changing for the better. If you stop & justify yourself, you're either lazy or just dumb (which is not so cool as a T).
